heading: 調整後非支配株主持分等の額及び調整項目の額の算出方法
text_ja: 第五条第一項第四号、第六条第一項第五号及び第七条第一項第五号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。一第五条第一項第四号に掲げる普通株式等Tier1資本に係る調整後非支配株主持分の額は、特定連結子法人等(連結子法人等(特別目的会社等を除く。以下この条において同じ。)のうち金融機関又はバーゼル銀行監督委員会の定める自己資本比率の基準若しくはこれと類似の基準(法第四十六条の六に定める自己資本規制比率を含む。第三十一条において同じ。)の適用を受ける者をいう。以下この号において同じ。)の非支配株主持分相当普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額(特定連結子法人等の単体普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額(第二条第一号の算式の分子の額の算出方法における普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額又はこれに相当する額をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち当該特定連結子法人等の最終指定親会社の連結貸借対照表の純資産の部に株式引受権、新株予約権又は非支配株主持分として計上される部分の額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち次に掲げる額のいずれか少ない額に普通株式等Tier1資本に係る第三者持分割合(特定連結子法人等の非支配株主持分相当普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額を単体普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額以下の額とする。イ当該特定連結子法人等の第二条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に七パーセントを乗じて得た額ロ第二条各号の算式の分母の額のうち当該特定連結子法人等に関連するものの額(当該特定連結子法人等の同条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に関連するものの額をいう。)に七パーセントを乗じて得た額二第六条第一項第五号に掲げるその他Tier1資本に係る調整後非支配株主持分等の額は、連結子法人等の非支配株主持分等相当Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額(連結子法人等の単体Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額(第二条第一号の算式の分子の額の算出方法における普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額及び同条第二号の算式の分子の額の算出方法におけるその他Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額の合計額又はこれに相当する額をいう。以下この項において同じ。)のうち当該連結子法人等の最終指定親会社の連結貸借対照表の純資産の部又は負債の部に株式引受権、新株予約権若しくは非支配株主持分又は負債として計上される部分の額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち次に掲げる額のいずれか少ない額にTier1資本に係る第三者持分割合(連結子法人等の非支配株主持分等相当Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額を単体Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額以下の額から、第五条第一項第四号に掲げる額を控除した額とする。イ当該連結子法人等の第二条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に八・五パーセントを乗じて得た額ロ第二条各号の算式の分母の額のうち当該連結子法人等に関連するものの額(当該連結子法人等の同条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に関連するものの額をいう。)に八・五パーセントを乗じて得た額三第七条第一項第五号に掲げるTier2資本に係る調整後非支配株主持分等の額は、連結子法人等の非支配株主持分等相当総自己資本に係る基礎項目の額(連結子法人等の単体総自己資本に係る基礎項目の額(連結子法人等の単体Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額及び第二条第三号の算式の分子の額の算出方法におけるTier2資本に係る基礎項目の額の合計額又はこれに相当する額をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち当該連結子法人等の最終指定親会社の連結貸借対照表の純資産の部又は負債の部に株式引受権、新株予約権若しくは非支配株主持分又は負債として計上される部分の額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち次に掲げる額のいずれか少ない額に総自己資本に係る第三者持分割合(連結子法人等の非支配株主持分等相当総自己資本に係る基礎項目の額を単体総自己資本に係る基礎項目の額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額以下の額から、第五条第一項第四号及び第六条第一項第五号に掲げる額の合計額を控除した額とする。イ当該連結子法人等の第二条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に十・五パーセントを乗じて得た額ロ第二条各号の算式の分母の額のうち当該連結子法人等に関連するものの額(当該連結子法人等の同条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に関連するものの額をいう。)に十・五パーセントを乗じて得た額
text_en: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv), Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v), and Article 7, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be calculated as follows. (i) The amount of adjusted minority interests relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital equivalent to minority interests of a specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning a consolidated subsidiary (excluding special purpose companies, etc.; the same applies hereinafter in this Article) that is a financial institution or is subject to capital adequacy ratio standards established by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision or similar standards (including the capital adequacy ratio prescribed in Article 46-6 of the Act; the same applies in Article 31); the same applies hereinafter in this item) by the amount of basic items relating to standalone Common Equity Tier 1 Capital), with such result being the maximum allowable amount: the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital equivalent to minority interests of a specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning the portion of the amount of basic items relating to standalone Common Equity Tier 1 Capital of the specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (i), or an equivalent amount; the same applies hereinafter in this item) that is recorded in the net assets section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such specified consolidated subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, or non-controlling interests (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this item). (a) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such specified consolidated subsidiary by 7%. (b) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 that is related to such specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning the amount related to the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of such Article of such specified consolidated subsidiary) by 7%. (ii) The amount of adjusted minority interests, etc. relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital set forth in Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) from the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to Tier 1 Capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to Tier 1 Capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary by the amount of basic items relating to standalone Tier 1 Capital), with such result being the maximum allowable amount: the amount of basic items relating to Tier 1 Capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary (meaning the portion of the amount of basic items relating to standalone Tier 1 Capital of the consolidated subsidiary (meaning the total of the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (i) and the amount of basic items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (ii), or an equivalent amount; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph) that is recorded in the net assets section or liabilities section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such consolidated subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, non-controlling interests, or liabilities (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this item). (a) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such consolidated subsidiary by 8.5%. (b) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 that is related to such consolidated subsidiary (meaning the amount related to the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of such Article of such consolidated subsidiary) by 8.5%. (iii) The amount of adjusted minority interests, etc. relating to Tier 2 Capital set forth in Article 7, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) and Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v) from the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to total capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to total capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary by the amount of basic items relating to standalone total capital), with such result being the maximum allowable amount: the amount of basic items relating to total capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary (meaning the portion of the amount of basic items relating to standalone total capital of a consolidated subsidiary (meaning the total of the amount of basic items relating to standalone Tier 1 Capital of the consolidated subsidiary and the amount of basic items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (iii), or an equivalent amount; the same applies hereinafter in this item) that is recorded in the net assets section or liabilities section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such consolidated subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, non-controlling interests, or liabilities (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this item). (a) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such consolidated subsidiary by 10.5%. (b) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 that is related to such consolidated subsidiary (meaning the amount related to the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of such Article of such consolidated subsidiary) by 10.5%.

clauses_en.text: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv), Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v), and Article 7, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be calculated as follows.

(i) The amount of adjusted minority interests relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) shall be an amount not exceeding the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to CET1 equivalent to minority interests of the specified consolidated subsidiary by the amount of basic items relating to standalone CET1), using as the base the amount of basic items relating to CET1 equivalent to minority interests of specified consolidated subsidiaries (meaning those consolidated subsidiaries, excluding special purpose companies, etc., that are subject to capital ratio standards of the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision or similar standards including the capital adequacy ratio under Article 46-6 of the Act; the same applies hereinafter in this item), which is the portion of standalone CET1 basic items of the specified consolidated subsidiary recorded as share subscription rights, share options, or non-controlling interests in the net assets section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such subsidiary (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (a) The amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such specified consolidated subsidiary multiplied by 7%. (b) The amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 related to such specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning the portion related to the equivalent denominator of such subsidiary) multiplied by 7%.

(ii) The amount of adjusted minority interests, etc. relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital set forth in Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) from an amount not exceeding the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to Tier 1 Capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to Tier 1 Capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary by the amount of standalone Tier 1 basic items), using as the base the amount of basic items relating to Tier 1 Capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of consolidated subsidiaries (meaning the portion of standalone Tier 1 Capital basic items recorded in the net assets section or liabilities section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, non-controlling interests, or liabilities; where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (a) The amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such consolidated subsidiary multiplied by 8.5%. (b) The amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 related to such consolidated subsidiary multiplied by 8.5%.

(iii) The amount of adjusted minority interests, etc. relating to Tier 2 Capital set forth in Article 7, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) and Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v) from an amount not exceeding the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to total capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to total capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary by the amount of standalone total capital basic items), using as the base the amount of basic items relating to total capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of consolidated subsidiaries (meaning the portion of standalone total capital basic items recorded in the net assets section or liabilities section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, non-controlling interests, or liabilities; where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (a) The amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such consolidated subsidiary multiplied by 10.5%. (b) The amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 related to such consolidated subsidiary multiplied by 10.5%.
